risk_note: RV2 (platform metrics / config, entry wiring, infra alert rules). D10-183 ② R-01, D10-193 ③: /metrics on an internal port only when METRICS_PORT is set (METRICS_HOST default 127.0.0.1), a separate HTTP server answering GET /metrics, not mounted on Nest and not in the OAS. The worker alone exports database-wide gauges by read-only SQL at scrape time: failed jobs per queue (incl. <queue>.dead), unhandled dead letters, due created backlog, oldest due created evt.* age, sync watermark lag per platform; every entry exports process-level metrics only. The Prometheus 0.0.4 text exposition is hand-written (the @prometheus-io/client chain cannot load under the protected vitest conditions; reported to the orchestrator). Metrics servers close when startup fails. infra/monitoring/rules/couli.yaml: queue failed, dead letters, oldest evt > 60 s, watermark lag > 30 min and three Redis alerts with severity labels. No money, no attribution, no migration.
